pluginstrument.author: CAP V-SAR
pluginstrument.description: Guarded master switch for the Mission Observer station's SAR mission kit (DF head, TDFM-136B FM radio, GMA 1347 audio panel/MFD feed). Lift the guard, then flip the switch to cut all mission equipment at once without touching the aircraft's own BAT/ALT/AVIONICS masters, matching how the mission kit is wired as supplemental equipment on the airframe bus.
